# `discarded-realloc-result`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an explicitly discarded slice returned by `realloc` or
`reallocAdvanced`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A successful reallocation may move the allocation and always returns the
authoritative new length. Continuing with the old slice can use an invalid
pointer or stale bounds.

## When it fires

Store the returned slice and replace the old binding. Calls whose result is
retained are not reported.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn resize(allocator: anytype, bytes: []u8) !void {
    _ = try allocator.realloc(bytes, 32);
}
```
